title: Detailed private tour of...
text: Detailed private tour of the Familia Sagrada basilica.  Jane was our guide and she was friendly and provided interesting details about the church.  It was a great tour.
author: George_R

title: Wonderful!  Excellent...
text:
Wonderful!  Excellent guide…very informative
Perfect time to visit is in the afternoon for the stained glass windows. The colors were spectacular
author: Herbert_S

title: Exceptional!
text: Our guide was exceptional! She met us promptly at the designated area, was extremely knowledgeable, perfect English speaker. She pointed out myriad details we would have missed without her guidance.
author: Bobbi_G

title: Superb experience with a superb guide.
text: Sagrada Família is a must see icon in Barcelona. Jana is a superb guide and we learned with her new facts about the cathedral, notwithstanding that this is our third visit to the site.
author: Alcides_R

title: Sagrada Familia- Guaudi’s Masterpiece
text: This is a must see. Nothing else like it. You could spend hours looking at all the details and still not capture everything. Guadi was a master designer and architect and his works are one of a kind. Our tour guide was so helpful and filled us with so much knowledge about his works and life.
author: Richard_Z

title: Sagrada Família
text: We had a wonderful, in depth lesson on the construction of the Sagrada Família.  Each element of the building was explained in great detail.  Our guide was excellent.  I highly recommend this tour!
author: Nannette_H

title: Private Sagrada Família Tour
text: Jane was amazing.  She was the perfect guide and was knowledgeable.   She spent a lot of time with us and made any accommodations we needed.  Great day
author: Don_H

title: It was Incredible
text: This was a great tour. Our tour guide was the best. She was very knowledgeable and took her time. She knew everything about the church.
author: Stephen_W

title: Private is the way to go at Sagrada Familia!
text: We loved our tour! Jane is a warm, knowledgeable, and passionate guide with great knowledge of Gaudi and the histoory of SF. We'd happily recommend her! And if you can, private is the way to go if you don't want to feel shuffled around in a crowded place!
author: Experience749542

title: Awesome experience
text: Excellent tour.  Jane our tour guide explained everything in detail.  2nd time here but still learned so much more!
author: John_S
